examples: Picnic, barbecue and playground facilities are located throughout the park.

words.general_translation_vi: Xuyên thành phố, xuyên thị xã
meanings: Going or extending across a town or city.
examples: He took a crosstown bus to school.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự trang bị
meanings: An instrumentality needed for an undertaking or to perform a service.
examples: The shop sold equypment for the journey.

words.general_translation_vi: Sự cấm, sự cấm chỉ
meanings: A court order prohibiting a party from doing a certain activity.
examples: The court issued an interdict on the sale.

words.general_translation_vi: Kết cấu, cấu trúc
meanings: A thing constructed.
examples: The structure of the poem is very complex.

words.general_translation_vi: Phòng uống bia (ở khách sạn)
meanings: A small restaurant serving beer and wine as well as food.
examples: We met in the brasserie for coffee.

words.general_translation_vi: Hợp lại
meanings: Considered the most highly evolved dicotyledonous plants, characterized by florets arranged in dense heads that resemble single flowers.
examples: The artist created a composite photograph of the city.

words.general_translation_vi: Khoảng đất giữa thành luỹ và thành phố
meanings: A long stretch of open level ground (paved or grassy) for walking beside the seashore.
examples: We walked along the esplanade after dinner.
